review_author.disclosure: Previously authored separate host/runtime boundary changes and CheckpointData Lean helpers; did not edit the Rust progress implementation reviewed here.

analysis.authority: ProgressResume decode is recognition only. Public CertifiedProgressPort installation verifies the actual certificate and committed summary under the installed context; crate-only borrowing relies on Client/Member accepted-history provenance. Core MessageStore implementations and restore_attested remain explicitly trusted evidence boundaries, not authentication APIs.
analysis.context: Safe checkpoint port compares installed protocol, target root, thread and protocol digest before exposing materialization. Native resolver independently checks protocol/thread and root when supplied. PositionContext.code is checked by the checkpoint adapter, not independently by the generic core resolver.
analysis.ranks: Wire format stores only native identity, verb and causal parents. Restore topologically orders records, rejects missing ancestors/cycles and recomputes expanded native steps and progress; no claimed rank field is accepted.
analysis.compactness: Position facts retain causal headers and computed native step sets, not original message bodies or unrelated selected fields. Persistent Arc treap/rank sharing and borrowed from_summary avoid prefix-body cloning/traversal on tail resolution. Metadata storage grows with accepted identities; this is not constant-space progress.
analysis.scope: No-repeat/no-Progress profiles omit the global cache. Protocol-none apply validates derived identity/verb, then returns without requiring a thread/root or retaining ancestry; native progress is always zero. The protocol-Some branch retains its prior native-position/context checks. Header-only safety evidence does not prove separate full-payload occupant completion or certificate truth independently of endorsement policy.
analysis.atomicity: Summary applies cloned persistent progress state into staged updates and publishes only after fallible preparation; missing parents do not partially install facts.
analysis.complexity_boundary: Treap balance is based on SHA-256 priorities; this review does not prove deterministic worst-case logarithmic balance, constant decode cost, OS cancellation or a production latency guarantee.
